status: frozen before any non-Tadarida endpoint-exclusion output was opened
trigger: The focal Tadarida 1-km x-y-only night-endpoint exclusion failed (p=0.1109), leaving departure/arrival or other central-place structure as a viable contributor. The five comparative panels had not yet been subjected to the same outcome-blind exclusion.

prior_fixed_tadarida_context.interpretation: central-place departure/arrival structure remains a viable contributor in the focal panel

proxy_definition.inputs: horizontal x-y and timestamp only from sessions already admitted under each frozen source contract; numeric vertical values are never used to define the proxy
proxy_definition.coordinate_system: use the already-frozen cohort-specific UTM projection for each comparative panel
proxy_definition.per_session_endpoint_set: first 5 and last 5 finite projected fixes after sorting the originally eligible session by timestamp
proxy_definition.center: medoid of all pooled endpoint fixes for that individual within that cohort; choose the observed endpoint minimizing summed Euclidean distance to all pooled endpoints
proxy_definition.rationale: matches the already-frozen focal Tadarida proxy construction and uses x-y/time only

exclusion_and_scoring.event_exclusion: remove every numeric-scored event whose Euclidean distance to its own individual-within-cohort proxy center is strictly less than the radius; apply to target and training events symmetrically
exclusion_and_scoring.session_identity: retain the original frozen session ID
exclusion_and_scoring.session_reeligibility: after exclusion require at least 50 numeric-scored events; otherwise drop the whole session
exclusion_and_scoring.cohort_membership: do not rediscover or expand cohorts; use only originally admitted cohorts and surviving sessions
exclusion_and_scoring.vertical_field_and_bins: unchanged from each panel's frozen source contract
exclusion_and_scoring.permutation_preserves: all within-session x-y-z observations after the fixed exclusion and the exact multiset of surviving session counts assigned to individual labels within cohort

manuscript_decision_matrix.all_five_comparative_panels_pass: May state that the five comparative panels retain calibrated vertical identity after the same 1-km night-endpoint exclusion. Because focal Tadarida already failed, do not claim universal independence from central-place structure; describe the contribution as panel-dependent.
manuscript_decision_matrix.one_or_more_comparative_panels_fail: Do not present the six-panel result as vertical individuality independent of central-place/end-point structure. Report which panels retain or lose support and state that repeatable 3-D airspace identity may include departure/arrival, roost/colony/lek, commuting, or other central-place-associated structure.
manuscript_decision_matrix.all_five_comparative_panels_fail: Reframe the ecological interpretation away from generic vertical specialization and toward repeatable individual 3-D airspace use potentially generated by central-place or endpoint-associated movement structure.
manuscript_decision_matrix.mechanism_language: Never infer a true roost, colony departure mechanism, or lek mechanism from this proxy alone.
manuscript_decision_matrix.title_rule: Regardless of outcome, replace 'horizontal occupancy' in the title with 'coarse horizontal occupancy' or explicit '5-km horizontal occupancy' before submission.

stop_rule: Do not alter endpoint-fix count, proxy-center algorithm, 1-km primary radius, 0.5/2-km descriptive radii, panel eligibility thresholds, grid, bins, smoothing, permutation counts, seeds, or cohort/session definitions after any new output is opened.
Retain failures and contradictory radius sensitivities.
Do not add verified or inferred roost/colony/lek coordinates after results are seen.
Do not reopen public source search.
